title: Tourist Season, 2007 · the next day
logline: The day after the tourist who came for the dog: the same tourist on the seawall with a bag of the good treats from the grocery, and the dog, eight, accepting them with dignity, and Wood not knowing where to stand. He stands where he always stands.

panels.composition: The seawall. A TOURIST crouched with a bag of dog treats. BARNABY accepting one with dignity. WOOD a few steps off, hands in his coat.
